content.subject: Quick thought on ShipBob’s recent funding
content.draft_text:
Hi Test,
ShipBob raised $200M, valuing it over $1B. That likely expands reconciliation workload across teams, increasing significant manual effort and error risk.
We build a platform that automatically matches and posts intercompany transactions, reducing duplicate entry and overall audit time and improving compliance.
Worth a 15-minute call next week?
